title: 清代在中国历史上的意义
originalTitle: The Significance of the Ch'ing Period in Chinese History

zh: 据 1967 年原刊第 189–195 页校订。页码沿用原刊，原注与校注分列。原著权利归原权利人。本版为非官方阅读版，翻译与校订使用了 AI 辅助。
en: Reading edition of the 1967 article. Page labels refer to the printed journal. Original notes are retained. Original copyright belongs to the rights holders. This is an unofficial reading edition.

zh: 清代通常被认为是中国历史上研究得较为充分、了解得较多的时期之一，但就我们已有知识的总量而言，其实远称不上充足。要系统讨论 1644 至 1912 年这整个时期的意义，需要大量论文、专著和新的综合性研究。既然本文的目的只是引起进一步的讨论和研究，那么我提出几条极为试探性的概括，想来尚可免于冒昧之咎。
en: ALTHOUGH the Ch'ing period is generally regarded as one of the better studied and understood periods of Chinese history, the existing fund of our knowledge is actually far from adequate. A systematic discussion of the significance of the entire period from 1644 to 1912 would require a large number of articles, monographs, and fresh syntheses. Since the purpose of this paper is merely to stimulate further discussion and research, I hope to be excused for making a few highly tentative generalizations.

zh: 清代的总体意义在于，从时间上说它处在传统与现代之间。未来的新中国无论发生多大变化，清代作为中国旧制度（
）的最后阶段，都已留下重要的遗产。清代将继续充当一个基准面，据以研究更早的时期，也据以分析今日中国的遗产。因此，要更充分地理解过去的中国与当代的中国，清代都是关键。
en: The general significance of the Ch'ing period is that chronologically it falls between what is traditional and what is modern. However much the new China changes in the future, the Ch'ing period, the last phase of China's

, has left important legacies. The Ch'ing period will continue to serve as a datum plane from which to study either the earlier periods or to analyze the heritage of present-day China. To understand more fully both earlier and contemporary China, therefore, the Ch'ing period is crucial.

zh: 清代的重要意义还有若干更具体的理由。第一，从地理上说，没有满洲统治者 1600 至 1800 年间艰辛、细致而娴熟的建构帝国之举（empire building），中国绝不可能达到今日的规模。既然今日中国对外部世界的许多影响来自其幅员与边疆的位置，那么清代对现代中国作为地理与族群实体之形成的贡献就最为重大。几个简单的统计数字即可说明部分情况。被称为"中国本部"的那片地区——在帝制时代的多数时候，它代表着中国有效管辖的极限——约为 1,532,800 平方英里，大约相当于美国国土面积的一半。到了清末，满洲帝国已从其极盛版图（这一极盛在十八世纪末达到）大幅收缩，中国仍拥有约 4,278,000 平方英里的面积，比中华人民共和国的面积大 606,000 平方英里。
en: The Ch'ing period is significant for a number of more specific reasons. First, geographically China could never have reached its present dimensions without the laborious, painstaking, and skillful work of empire building carried out by Manchu rulers between 1600 and 1800. Since much of present-day China's impact on the outside world is due to its size and the location of its frontiers, the contribution of the Ch'ing period to the formation of modern China as a geographic and ethnic entity is of the greatest significance. Simple statistics will tell part of the story. The area known as China proper, which throughout much of the imperial age represented the limits of effective Chinese jurisdiction, amounts roughly to 1,532,800 square miles, which is about one-half the area of the United States. By late Ch'ing, when the Manchu empire had shrunk considerably from its fullest extent (reached by the end of the eighteenth century), China still embraced an area of approximately 4,278,000 square miles, which is 606,000 square miles larger than the area of the People's Republic of China.

zh: 诚然，汉唐极盛之时，中国帝国的势力西至今日俄属突厥斯坦（Russian Turkestan）的一部分，而蒙古帝国是人类编年史上疆域最大的帝国。但汉唐的西向扩张最多只是昙花一现，蒙古世界帝国的组织又过于松散，未能留下任何持久的印记。相形之下，只有满洲人能够制定长远的控制政策，设计出复杂的行政与军事机构，使这个中国历史上幅员最大而统治稳固的帝国得以长久存续。
en: It is true that at the peak of the Han and T'ang dynasties the Chinese empire reached as far west as parts of present-day Russian Turkestan, and that the Mongol empire is the largest in the annals of man. But the westward expansion of Han and T'ang was ephemeral at best, and the Mongol world empire was too loosely organized to leave any permanent imprint. In contrast, the Manchus alone were able to work out long-range policies of control and to design complex administrative and military apparatus by which to make the largest consolidated empire in Chinese history endure.

zh: 除蒙古人的元帝国以及拓跋魏这类更早的非汉族帝国之外，任何一个中国王朝所能企及的最好程度，也就是把长城变成抵御北方游牧民族的有效防线。早期满洲统治者凭借与蒙古人地理上的邻近，尤其凭借远见，早在 1644 年之前就已确立了对内蒙古蒙古人的基本长远政策，并且沿行至王朝末年，其间不断扩充。这项政策的内容是：皇室宗族与蒙古各部累世通婚；定期给蒙古统治阶层的各个层级授予爵位；清廷认可喇嘛教为蒙古人的宗教；建立从
（盟）直到
（旗）的行政机构，这既契合蒙古旧俗，又便于满洲人实行分而治之。所有这些以及更多的事务，都由北京的理藩院（
，原文英译作 Court of Colonial Affairs，"殖民事务院"）统辖。此外，相当数量的蒙古人被纳入八旗，也在中央和各省的行政机构中任事。清初律例虽禁止汉人进入为蒙古游牧者保留的地区，但从十七世纪末起，清廷对汉人移居内蒙古实则听之任之，饥荒之年尤其如此。汉人移民也得到了蒙古贵族的默许，因为他们发现自己作为
（食租者）的新角色有利可图。凡有相当规模的汉人农业移民聚落建立之处，清廷就设立正规的地方行政机构，也就是县与府。由于清末汉人向北方草原的迁移已具规模，内蒙古日益汉化。内蒙古草原在满洲人兴起之前始终处于中国文明的圈外，它与中国其余地区的整合，完全是清代的贡献。类似的汉人向满洲（东北）的迁移，尤其十九世纪中叶以后的迁移，尽管有沙俄与日本的侵凌，仍使满洲彻底中国化。
en: With the exception of the Mongol Yuan empire and such earlier non-Chinese empires as the To-pa Wei, the best that any Chinese dynasty could hope for was to make the Great Wall an effective front line of defense against the northern nomads. Thanks to their geographic propinquity to the Mongols and especially to their far-sightedness, the early Manchu rulers had worked out, even before 1644, a basic long-range policy towards the Mongols of Inner Mongolia, which was continued and amplified down to the very end of the dynasty. The policy consisted of perennial intermarriage between the imperial clan and Mongol principalities; periodic conferring of noble ranks on various strata of the Mongol ruling class; the endorsement by the imperial government of Lamaism as the religion for the Mongols; the setting-up of administrative machinery from
(principalities),
, (leagues), down to
(banners), which not only suited Mongol customs but also allowed the Manchus to follow a policy of divide and rule. All these, and much else, were supervised from Peking by

, or the Court of Colonial Affairs. In addition, a significant number of Mongols were incorporated into the Eight Banner system and into the central and provincial administration. Although early Ch'ing statutes prohibited the Chinese from entering the domains reserved for Mongol nomads, the imperial government from the late seventeenth century onwards connived at Chinese migrations to Inner Mongolia, especially in times of famine. Chinese immigration also received the tacit blessing of Mongol nobles who found their new role as

profitable. Wherever sizable Chinese agricultural colonies were established, the imperial government set up regular local administrations, that is, counties and prefectures. Since by late Ch'ing times Chinese migrations to the northern steppe had become large-scale, Inner Mongolia had become increasingly sinicized. The integration with the rest of China of the Inner Mongolian steppe, which prior to the advent of the Manchus had always been outside the pale of Chinese civilization, was exclusively a Ch'ing contribution. Similar Chinese migrations to Manchuria, especially from the middle of the nineteenth century onwards, have made Manchuria thoroughly Chinese, despite the onslaughts of Czarist Russia and Japan.

zh: 十七世纪末、十八世纪初，为保卫喀尔喀（外蒙古）免遭来自中国突厥斯坦北部的好战的准噶尔人之侵扰，满洲人不得不卷入一系列旷日持久的战争，其结果是确立了中国对外蒙古与西藏的宗主权，并征服了库库诺尔（Kokonor，今青海）与中国突厥斯坦。满洲人对这些辽阔地区的控制效力，与距离、地形、兵员与物资运输以及财政资源等困难的程度成反比。清代对边远地区这套复杂的控制体系大体上是精巧而可行的，一些众所周知的事实即可为证：中国突厥斯坦与库库诺尔分别在 1884 年和 1928 年被建为新疆、青海两省；驻拉萨的钦差与驻军直到 1912 年王朝覆亡之后才撤走；外蒙古直到 1946 年 1 月才在法律上脱离中国。
en: The need in the late seventeenth and early eighteenth centuries to defend Khalkha (Outer Mongolia) from the warlike Dzungars of Northern Chinese Turkestan led the Manchus to a long series of wars which resulted in the establishment of Chinese suzerainty over Outer Mongolia and Tibet and the conquest of Kokonor and Chinese Turkestan. The effectiveness of Manchu control of these far-flung regions varied inversely in proportion to the magnitude of such difficulties as distance, terrain, transportation of men and supplies and financial resources. That the complex Ch'ing system of control of these outlying areas was by and large ingenious and viable may be evidenced by the well-known facts; namely, that Chinese Turkestan and Kokonor were made into new provinces of Sinkiang and Chinghai respectively in 1884 and 1928, that the imperial resident and garrisons in Lhasa were not withdrawn until after the fall of the dynasty in 1912, and that Outer Mongolia did not legally secede from China until January, 1946.

zh: 1842 年以后，清帝国不得不领教现代强权政治的严酷现实。俄国、英国、法国与日本一步一步地把中国边远地区与藩属的法律地位问题变成了一个几乎纯属学术的问题。各方都从
（现实政治）中学到，中国任何边缘地区的真实地位取决于中国行使有效控制的能力。正是这一严酷的历史教训，促使中华人民共和国一有机会就把军队开进新疆与西藏。
en: After 1842, the Ch'ing empire was compelled to learn the harsh realities of modern power politics. Step by step, Russia, Britain, France, and Japan reduced the question of the legal status of China's outlying regions and dependent states to an almost purely academic one. Every party had learned from

that the true status of any of China's peripheral areas depended on China's ability to exert effective control. It is this rude historical lesson that prompted the People's Republic of China to seize the earliest possible opportunities to rush its army into Sinkiang and Tibet.

zh: 在总结清代的领土遗产之前，应当指出：清代中国内部边疆的拓展，虽不如开疆建国那样壮观，其历史重要性却并不稍逊。中国内部边疆拓展的历史几乎与中国历史本身一样悠久，但从雍正朝（1723–1735）起，朝廷开始对各个非汉族群推行力度更大的汉化政策——他们构成了湖南山地飞地、鄂西高原以及云南、贵州、四川、广西若干山区的多数。这项政策的核心，是以普通的中国地方行政取代土著部族制度。1723 年至 1912 年间，这一政策也推行于甘肃、库库诺尔、中国突厥斯坦以及西藏东部的部分地区，后者在 1928 至 1949 年间被建为西康省。值得一提的是，即使在清朝最后几年，这一政策在西康再度加强。若无西南内部边疆的拓展与巩固，很难设想西南地区在 1937 至 1945 年那段关键岁月里能够如此成功地充当中国对日作战的最后领土基地。因此，无论对外还是对内，清代对现代中国作为地理实体之形成都具有最重要的意义。
en: Before summing up the Ch'ing territorial bequest, it should be pointed out that the extension of China's internal frontiers in Ch'ing times, if less spectacular than empire-building, is historically equally important. Although the history of the extension of China's internal frontiers is almost as old as Chinese history itself, it was from the Yung-cheng period (1723-1735) onwards that a more energetic policy of sinicization was directed against the various non-Han ethnic groups who constituted the majority in the hilly enclaves of Hunan, the highlands of Western Hupei, and a number of mountainous districts of Yunnan, Kweichow, Szechwan, and Kwangsi. The core of this policy was to replace the native tribal system with ordinary Chinese local administration. Between 1723 and 1912 this policy was applied also to parts of Kansu, Kokonor, Chinese Turkestan, and eastern Tibet, which was made into Sikang province between 1928 and 1949. It is worth mentioning that even the last few years of the Manchu dynasty witnessed a recrudesence of this policy in Sikang. Without the extension and consolidation of the southwestern internal frontiers, it is doubtful that the southwest could have served so well as China's last territorial base of operation against Japan during the critical years from 1937 to 1945. Externally, as well as internally, therefore, the Ch'ing period is of greatest importance to the formation of modern China as a geographic entity.

children: 现代中国从清代继承的第二项重要遗产

zh: ，是庞大的人口。清代以前，中国官方登记人口的最高记录是 60,000,000，尽管有理由相信，在更早的某些时期——例如宋、明两代的后半期——人口很可能已超过 100,000,000。不过基本事实仍是：除非经济与制度因素的组合格外有利，前工业人口一般不可能长期保持高增长率。我在《中国人口研究，1368–1953》（

children: Studies on the Population of China, 1368-1953

zh: 一书中曾讨论过，从 1683 年国内和平与繁荣的肇端，到乾隆后期中国人口飙升至 300,000,000 的这一百年里，这样一组有利的经济与制度因素确实存在。即使人口—土地比率日益不利、经济状况不断恶化，也未能阻止人口仅凭增长惯性在 1850 年达到 430,000,000。现代中国固然一直被人口过剩与大众贫困所困，但如今估计 700,000,000 的人口，被历史上最具斯巴达色彩的国家严酷地组织和管束起来，其影响不可能不显现。要理解这种人口规模所产生的影响的历史根源，清代同样关键。
en: that modern China has received from the Ch'ing is her large population. Prior to the Ch'ing the peak officially registered population of China was 60,000,000, although there is reason to believe that during certain earlier periods, such as latter halves of Sung and Ming, the population may well have exceeded 100,000,000. The basic fact remains, however, that a preindustrial population could not as a rule grow at a sustained high rate unless the combined economic and institutional factors were unusually favorable. As has been discussed in my

children: Studies on the Population of China, 1368-1953

en: such a combination of favorable economic and institutional factors did exist in the century from the dawn of domestic peace and prosperity in 1683 to the late Ch'ien-lung era when China's population had shot up to 300,000,000. Even an increasingly unfavorable population-land ratio and deteriorating economic conditions could not prevent the population from reaching 430,000,000 by 1850 through sheer momentum. While modern China had unquestionably been plagued by overpopulation and mass poverty, her present estimated population of 700,000,000, when ruthlessly regimented by the most Spartan state in history, cannot fail to make its impact felt. To understand the historical roots of this impact of numbers, the Ch'ing period is again crucial.

children: 第三，清代无疑是中国历史上最成功的征服王朝

zh: ，其成功的关键在于早期满洲统治者采取了系统汉化的政策。清代因此为研究涵化（acculturation）的复杂过程提供了一个极好的个案，也有助于我们进一步认识中国传统制度与文化的内在力量。篇幅不允许我系统解释早期满洲统治者为何必须采取这样的政策。只需在此说明：对一个在人数上被汉人远远压倒的征服族群来说，最有效的长远政策，就是去扶植那个被中华民族——尤其是作为关键社会阶层的士大夫与官僚——视为正统的制度与文化体系。五世纪末北魏孝文帝的系统汉化，与 1598 年法国亨利四世改宗天主教，都是出于类似的政治需要。

children: Thirdly, the Ch'ing is without doubt

en: the most successful dynasty of conquest in Chinese history, and the key to its success was the adoption by early Manchu rulers of a policy of systematic sinicization. The Ch'ing period thus provides an excellent case study for the complex processes of acculturation which in turn helps to sharpen our perception of the inherent strength of traditional Chinese institutions and culture. Space does not allow a systematic explanation of the reasons why early Manchu rulers had to adopt such a policy. Suffice it to say here that for a conquering ethnic group so vastly outnumbered by the Chinese, the most effective long-range policy was to sponsor the very institutional and cultural system which the Chinese nation, especially the key social class of scholars and officials, regarded as orthodox. The systematic sinicization of the Hsiao-wen emperor of Northern Wei late in the fifth century and the conversion to Catholicism of Henry IV of France in 1598 were dictated by similar political necessities.

zh: 满洲皇室、贵族与官员的系统汉化，可以从下列事实得到证明：王朝一开始就完整采纳（

）明代的政府体制，并辅以几项满洲人创制的制度，使之更为完善、合理；康熙皇帝及其后继者极力推崇宋代后期理学中关于社会和政治关系的保守、消极主张，并奉之为官方正统；清帝对孔子致以前所未有的尊崇（在北京行二跪六叩，在孔子故里曲阜行三跪九叩）；设计并维持中国历史上最严格的皇子教育，其内容大体以正统儒学为主；以儒学正统为依据，废除满洲固有的八旗制度内部各层封建隶属关系；以官方之力大规模刊刻、流布古代经典与程朱学派的新儒学著作，以及文学工具书和选集，其顶点即为《四库全书》（
）的编纂；以及对中国的文学、书法、绘画和娱乐的日益沉迷。
en: Systematic sinicization of the Manchu imperial clan, nobility, and officials may be evidenced by the following facts: the adoption from the beginning of the dynasty of the Ming government system

, which, with a few Manchu innovations, was improved and rationalized; the ardent endorsement by the K'ang-hsi emperor and his successors of the conservative and passive aspects of social and political relationships in later Sung Neo-Confucianism as official orthodoxy; the unprecedented homage that the Ch'ing emperors paid to Confucius (two kneelings and six prostrations in Peking and three kneelings and nine prostrations in Confucius' birthplace, Ch'ü-fu); the designing and maintaining of the strictest education for imperial princes in Chinese history based largely on orthodox Confucianism; the utilization of Confucian orthodoxy as a justification for abolishing the various layers of feudal relationships within the indigenous Manchu Eight Banner system; the large-scale printing and dissemination under imperial auspices of ancient classics and Neo-Confucian writings of the Ch'eng-Chu school and literary reference tools and anthologies which culminated in the compilation of the
; and the increasing addiction to Chinese literature, calligraphy, painting, and entertainments.

zh: 诚然，康熙、雍正、乾隆这样格外有为的君主并非没有意识到保存满洲某些特性与习俗的重要。但中国文化的熔炉作用如此之强，以致到十八世纪后半叶，朝廷所倡导的满洲本位意识已萎缩得所剩无几，只剩下皇子与满洲应试者须练习骑马射箭、学习满洲语这一法定义务，尽管满洲萨满教似乎延续到了王朝末年。有明确证据表明，至迟到十九世纪初，满洲语即使在皇子中也已成了死语言。此外有大量证据显示，整个清代族际婚姻一直存在，康熙长期在位期间与王朝末年尤多。满洲旗人因与汉人在城乡长期混居而日益贫困，这一点众所周知，无须多论。
en: It is true that such unusually able rulers as K'ang-hsi, Yung-cheng, and Ch'ien-lung did not fail to realize the importance of preserving certain Manchu traits and customs. But so effective was the crucible of Chinese culture that by the latter half of the eighteenth century the imperially exhorted Manchu nativism had boiled down to little more than a legal obligation on the part of imperial princes and Manchu examination candidates to practice horsemanship and archery and to study the Manchu language, although Manchu Shamanism seems to have survived till the end of the dynasty. There is definite evidence that even for imperial princes, Manchu had become a dead language by the beginning of the nineteenth century at the latest. Furthermore, there is ample evidence that interethnic marriage went on throughout the Ch'ing period, especially during the long reign of K'ang-hsi and toward the end of the dynasty. The fact that Manchu Bannermen suffered progressive impoverishment as a result of their prolonged mingling with the Chinese in both urban and rural areas is too well known to need any elaboration.

zh: 事实上，满洲人汉化之深，使我们所认作正统儒家国家与社会的许多东西，其范例不在早先的中国王朝，而在清代。只需提一句：宋代儒家国家在其形成阶段以思想与政策的显著多样、以及没有官方认定的正统而著称。明太祖虽选定程朱学派为正统，他的后继者却没有一人真正关心意识形态。即便是宣宗（1425–1435）这样有才的明代君主，也曾因某位官员进言，说应当任命若干博学的官员辅佐皇帝研习宋儒真德秀的《大学衍义》（

，原文释为 Systematic Exposition of the Book of Great Learning），而把这位官员连同家小一并下狱。相形之下，自康熙亲政直到清亡，被选为帝师以及在春、秋两季为皇帝讲读儒家经典的讲官，无一不是程朱学派的学者。无论好坏，正是在外族满洲人的统治下，中国变成了一个严格遵奉"正统"的儒家国家。此前的中国历史上，从未有过一个时期，今日研究者所说的儒家规范、习俗与价值渗透得如此之深，又如此广为人们接受。
en: In fact, so sinicized were the Manchus that much of what we regard as the orthodox Confucian state and society is exemplified not by earlier Chinese dynasties, but the Ch'ing period. We need mention only that in its formative stage the Sung Confucian state is known for its remarkable diversity of thought and policy and for its absence of officially endorsed orthodoxy. In spite of the Ming founder's choice of the Ch'eng-Chu school as orthodoxy, none of his successors showed any real concern for ideology. Even as gifted a Ming ruler as Hsüan-tsung (1425-1435) sent an official and his family to prison upon the latter's remonstrance that certain erudite officials should be appointed to help the emperor to study the Sung scholar Chen Te-hsiu's

(Systematic Exposition of the Book of Great Learning). In contrast, from K'ang-hsi's majority to the end of Ch'ing the officials selected to serve as imperial tutors and as special lecturers on Confucian classics for the emperor in spring and autumn were all scholars of the Ch'eng-Chu school. For good or for evil, it was under the alien Manchu rule that China became a strictly conformist "orthodox" Confucian state. In no earlier period of Chinese history do we find a deeper permeation and wider acceptance of the norms, mores, and values which modern students regard as Confucian.

zh: 尽管代价在所难免，满洲人系统汉化与儒家化的政策却极为有效地服务于王朝利益。满洲人统治中国 268 年，而蒙古人统治全中国不过 89 年。尽管有种种缺点与高压措施，康熙、雍正与乾隆前期仍构成中国历史上少有的时期之一，全国多数人口在其中享有和平、富足与安乐。1851 年太平天国起事，终极考验到来之时，中国民众中的大多数——尤其是作为关键社会阶层的士大夫与官僚——却忠诚地为他们的满洲主子作战，因为所谓异族王朝实际上比此前的中国王朝更为儒家。
en: Despite its inevitable cost, the Manchu policy of systematic sinicization and Confucianization served dynastic interests extremely well. The Manchus ruled China for a period of 268 years, as compared to a mere 89 years of Mongol rule of all China. For all their shortcomings and repressive measures, the eras of K'ang-hsi, Yung-cheng and early Ch'ien-lung constituted one of the rare periods in Chinese history in which the majority of the nation enjoyed peace, prosperity, and contentment. When the supreme test came in 1851 with the outbreak of the Taiping rebellion, the majority of the Chinese nation, especially the key social class of scholars and officials, fought loyally for their Manchu masters because the so-called alien dynasty had been, in fact, more Confucian than previous Chinese dynasties.

children: 第四，尽管旧秩序在王朝末年已然崩溃

zh: ，清代整体上仍须被视为传统政治、经济与社会制度更为成熟、经济与社会在区域之间进一步整合的时期。

children: Fourthly, despite the collapse of the old order by the end of the dynasty

en: , the Ch'ing period on the whole must be regarded as one in which traditional political, economic, and social institutions attained greater maturity and the economy and society achieved a greater degree of interregional integration.

zh: 就政治制度而言，清代显然受益于宋、明等早期时期长期的摸索与试错。比较唐代以来各朝的行政法即可发现，在各官署的职权与相互关系、文书的分类与传递、决策及其后续执行的程序、以及铨选、处分等一系列规章方面，清代制度显得更为细密、更为规整、更为合理。
en: As to political institutions, the Ch'ing definitely benefited from the prolonged trial and error of such earlier periods as Sung and Ming. A comparison of the administrative law of various dynasties since the T'ang reveals that in matters such as jurisdictions of and the interrelations between various offices, the classification and transmission of documents, the procedures by which decisions were made and subsequently executed, and a wide range of regulations on appointment, discipline, etc., the Ch'ing system appears to have been more meticulous, regularized, and rational.

zh: 诚然，很少有什么社会与经济制度起源于清代。众所周知，商人行会与手工业行会至少可上溯到唐代，现代类型的父系宗族可上溯到 1050 年，民间书院与资助应试士子的公款制度也可上溯到宋代。同样，从孤儿院、贫民义冢到救火队、救生船局等各类民间慈善机构，也都起源于早期时期。这些机构在早期的形成阶段或许只是零星出现、缺乏充分支持或地域分布有限，到清代则发展得更为充分，也更为普遍。
en: It is true that few if any social and economic institutions originated in Ch'ing times. As is well known, merchant and craft guilds can be traced back at least to the T'ang, the modern type of patrilineal clan to 1050, private academies and the system of community chests for examination candidates also to the Sung. Likewise, various nongovernment benevolent institutions ranging from orphanages and community cemeteries for the poor to fire-squads and life-saving boats had all originated in earlier periods. Whereas during earlier formative periods they may have been sporadic, inadequately supported, or of limited geographic distribution, by the Ch'ing period they reached fuller development and became more common.

zh: 一个足以说明经济与社会制度趋于成熟、并显示区域间经济与社会整合更进一步的绝佳例子，是清代各种以同乡关系为基础的自愿结社纷纷涌现，通称为会馆（
，德文
）。就现存记载所能查考，会馆最早在北京登场，其形式是 1420 年代初期为在中央政府任职的安徽芜湖同乡（

）所设的专属会所。自 1560 年起，若干地域性商帮开始在京师设立自己的会馆。到十六世纪末、十七世纪初，由各地域的商人与工匠所设的会馆开始出现在长江下游的大城市与少数繁荣市镇。然而在清代，江苏南部的苏州城一地便拥有多达 41 处会馆，而由来自几乎中国各地的同乡团体所设的行会更多。清末仅北京一地即有会馆近 400 所，代表所有省份和数十个富庶的府县，并主要用作赴会试的同乡士子的客栈。从我近来的拙著《中国会馆史论》（
，副题

children: An Historical Survey of Landsmannschaften in China

zh: 可以看出，到晚清，会馆无论是对所有社会身份开放、还是仅限同乡行会成员，都已存在于所有省会、大小沿海与内河口岸、若干县以下集镇，以及许多既不以贸易著称也不以工艺著称的偏僻内陆县份。密度最高者在四川，几乎每县都有至少数处由远方移民建立的会馆，一些县多至四五十处。
en: An excellent example by which to illustrate the maturing of economic and social institutions and to indicate greater interregional economic and social integration is the multiplication in Ch'ing times of various types of voluntary associations based on common geographic origin, generally called
). As far as can be ascertained from extant records, the
made its debut in Peking in the early fourteen twenties in the form of an exclusive club for
of Wuhu, Anhwei, who served as officials of the central government. From 1560 on, some regional merchant groups began to establish their
in the nation's capital. By the late sixteenth and early seventeenth centuries,

established by merchants and craftsmen of various geographic origins began to appear in major cities and a few prosperous towns of the lower Yangtze. During Ch'ing times, however, the city of Soochow, southern Kiangsu, boasted as many as 41
and many more guilds established by various
groups who came from virtually every part of China. In late Ch'ing there were nearly 400
in Peking alone which represented all the provinces and scores of prosperous prefectures and counties and which served mainly as hosteries for
candidates for the metropolitan examinations. From my recent book,

children: An Historical Survey of Landsmannschaften in China

en: it is shown that by late Ch'ing times,

guilds, existed in all provincial capitals, major and minor coastal and inland ports, certain sub-county towns, and many obscure inland counties noted neither for their trade nor crafts. The highest density is found in Szechwan, where practically every county had at least a few
established by immigrants from afar and some counties had as many as 40 or 50.

zh: 在四川以及其他有详备地方史或新出碑刻资料可据的大城市里，我们得知各种同乡团体往往合并成用今天的话说可称为商会的组织，并参与有关整个地方社区福利的事务。各同乡团体与本地人之间持续往来，常致联姻，从而实现社会同化。西方与日本多位学者认为，会馆在清代的盛行反映了中国异常强烈的地方本位主义，因而迟滞了中国经济与社会的现代化；与这种印象相反，数以千计的会馆存在于中国各地、不同的同乡团体在大小城市中共处一城这一事实，不可能不促进区域间的经济与社会整合——这一进程即使在政治离析的清末与民国初年也在快速推进。
en: In Szechwan and elsewhere in major cities where detailed local history or new inscriptional data are available, we learn that various

groups tended to merge into what in modern terms may be called chambers of commerce, and to take part in matters concerning the welfare of the entire local community. Constant contacts between various
groups and natives often resulted in intermarriage and brought about social assimilation. Contrary to the impressions of various Western and Japanese scholars that the prevalence of
in Ch'ing times reflected an unusually strong local particularism in China and hence has retarded the modernization of Chinese economy and society, the existence of thousands of
in all parts of China and the coexistence of various

groups in the same major and minor cities could not but have facilitated interregional economic and social integration—a process which went on apace even during the late Ch'ing and early Republican period of political disintegration.

children: 第五，在物质文化与艺术方面

zh: ，清代可被视为在从容发展中日渐充实、丰富的时期。物质文化之所以进展显著、并进而刺激更大范围的文化成长，一个基本原因是 1683 年
（中华和平）肇端之后那个罕见的、繁荣与仁厚的专制并存的百年。清代物质文化的领域显然过于广阔，我们无法作出任何试探性的概括。就本文的目的而言，我们只能从较好的地方志中推想：各行各业与手工艺的分工日益细密，供大众消费与精英消费的物品种类、范围与数量更为扩大。长江下游的富商大贾虽立下炫耀性消费的新标准，相当大的一部分人口的生活水平却仍在上升。

children: Fifthly, in material culture and the arts

en: , the Ch'ing period may be regarded as one of leisurely fulfillment and enrichment. One basic reason for the remarkable advancement in material culture which in turn stimulated broader cultural growth was the rare century of prosperity and benevolent despotism following the dawning of

in 1683. The field of Ch'ing material culture is obviously too vast to enable us to make any tentative generalization. For the present purpose, we can only surmise from better-quality local histories that the division of labor in trades and crafts became increasingly minute and that the range, variety and volume of articles for mass and elite consumption became even greater. While the merchant princes of the lower Yangtze set new standards of conspicuous consumption, a rising standard of living was nevertheless enjoyed by substantial segments of the population.

zh: 这一百年和平与繁荣所见证的，除许多其他事情之外，还有对书籍空前的需求与供给，以及大藏书家与艺术鉴赏家的兴起。以朝廷为首——自康熙亲政以后，朝廷便开始大规模地编纂、校勘、刊刻书籍并搜集艺术品——长江下游的富商大贾与许多官员和殷实学者纷纷效法。精英阶层以研习学术与艺术为风尚虽是全国性现象，但长江下游在这整个世纪里始终是中国文化活动的中心。正是下游地区的财富、闲暇、宏富的藏书与艺术收藏，以及较为成熟的文化生活，为下列现象提供了条件：以研究本身为目的的学术兴起；以石涛（Shih-t'ao）与扬州诸家（Yang-Chou masters）为代表的富于表现力的画派蓬勃兴盛，他们与隐逸者八大山人（Pa-ta-shan-jen）一起，启迪了赵之谦（1829–1884）、任颐（更常称任伯年，1840–1895）、吴昌硕（1844–1927）、齐白石（1862–1957）这样的近代巨匠；以及包括后来被多少有些误称为"京剧"的那个剧种在内的各派戏曲的成熟。
en: This century of peace and prosperity witnessed, among many things, an unprecedented demand for and supply of books and the rise of great bibliophiles and art connoisseurs. Led by the imperial court which since K'ang-hsi's majority had begun to compile, edit, and print books and to collect art on a grand scale, the merchant princes of the lower Yangtze and many officials and well-to-do scholars followed suit. While the vogue of cultivating scholarly and artistic avocations by the elite was a national phenomenon, the lower Yangtze area remained throughout this century the center of Chinese cultural activities. It was largely the wealth, leisure, great libraries and art collections, and the over-all sophistication of the lower Yangtze area that provided opportunities for the rise of research scholarship as an end in itself; for the flowering of the wonderful school of expressionistic painters led by Shih-t'ao and the Yang-Chou masters, who, along with the hermit Pa-ta-shan-jen, inspired such modern giants as Chao Chih-ch'ien (1829-1884), Jen I, better known as Jen Po-nien (1840-1895), Wu Ch'ang-shih (1844-1927), and Ch'i Po-shih (1862-1957); for the maturing of various schools of opera, including the one which was later somewhat erroneously called Peking opera.

zh: 约 1800 年长江下游富商大贾衰落后，文化活动在地理上分布更为均衡，触及更广的公众。就文化活动的范围与其渗透程度而言，我们几乎没有理由同意那种一度颇有影响的看法，即认为清代是文化与艺术停滞的时期。
en: After the decline of lower Yangtze merchant princes by about 1800, cultural activities became geographically more evenly spread and reached a wider public. In terms of the range of cultural activities and of their degree of permeation, there is little reason to agree with the erstwhile influential view that the Ch'ing period was one of cultural and artistic stagnation.

zh: 若干在我看来对解释中国历史上最成熟帝国的衰亡具有首要意义的基本因素。第一，由于
这一百年间经济与制度因素格外有利，到十八世纪末，人口膨胀已达空前规模，引发了一系列中国既有技术知识无力应对的新经济问题。第二，乾隆朝虽有表面的隆盛，实为法令与实际做法的落差日益扩大、贪墨逐渐蔓延的时期；从《文献丛编》（

所刊三批军机处密档来看，这种贪墨至少在 1776 至 1799 年间，可能已遍及全国并走向半制度化。正是乾隆朝以降的普遍贪墨，把康熙、雍正仁厚的专制变成了酷虐的专制，而白莲教起事及其后的诸起叛乱与此大有关系。第三，太平军战争的紧迫迫使 1850 年以后的清政府以中国历史上罕见的规模卖官——太平天国以后的许多政治家与官员视之为一切行政弊病的根源。第四，太平天国期间及其后，政治上有日益分权之势，其成因一是督抚权力的扩张，二是督抚日益无力对地方官实行有效管束。第五，在漫长历史中，中国第一次被西方卷入现代世界政治的漩涡，而西方文化在许多方面与中国匹敌，在若干关键方面且胜于中国。鸦片战争以前，这些因素中的若干项虽已使满洲帝国有所削弱，但最终导致清朝覆亡与传统中国制度和儒家文化解体的，是 1840 年以后所有这些因素的汇聚与互动。

children: Lastly, an attempt shall be made

en: to point out certain basic factors which appear to me of primary significance in accounting for the decline and fall of the maturest empire in Chinese history. To begin with, thanks to the existence of unusually favorable economic and institutional factors during the century of

, by the late eighteenth century the population explosion had reached unprecedented proportions and created a set of new economic problems with which China's existing fund of technological knowledge failed to cope. Second, for all its outward grandeur, the era of Ch'ien-lung was one of widening discrepancy between law and practice and of creeping peculation, which, judging from the three installments of confidential Grand Council archives published in

may have become nation-wide and semi-institutionalized, at least between 1776 and 1799. It was the widespread peculation from the Ch'ien-lung era onwards that transformed the benevolent despotism of K'ang-hsi and Yung-cheng into a malevolent despotism that had so much to do with the outbreak of the White Lotus and subsequent rebellions. Third, the exigency of the Taiping wars forced the post-1850 Ch'ing government to resort to the sale of office on a scale seldom paralleled in Chinese history—a factor which was regarded by many a post-Taiping statesman and official as the taproot of all administrative evils. Fourth, during and after the Taiping rebellion there was a tendency toward increasing political decentralization caused by the growth of the powers of the provincial authorities and by the increasing inability of the provincial authorities to exert effective control over the local officials. Fifth, for the first time in her long history, China was brought into the maelstrom of modern world politics by the West, whose culture was in many ways her equal and in some crucial ways her superior. While prior to the Opium War the working of some of these factors had contributed to the weakening of the Manchu empire, it was the convergence and interplay of all these factors after 1840 that eventually brought about the downfall of the Ch'ing dynasty and the disintegration of traditional Chinese institutions and Confucian culture.

en: The author is James Westfall Thompson Professor of History at the University of Chicago.
